profile.summary: Third-year Software Engineering student at FST, on the grid for a PFE seat in DevOps, web or AI. I race an application through its whole life — first interface to the pipeline that ships it. Two race seats already run: a contact platform in production with CI and Docker, a microservices stack with Jenkins and Terraform on AWS — and AI features built under hackathon clocks. AWS Cloud Practitioner licensed — ready for a team that keeps real systems running.

about.title: Engineer on the grid
about.description: I care about the whole life of an application — clean backend logic, solid interfaces, and the pipelines that ship them and keep them running.
paragraphs: Alongside my engineering degree at FST, I've completed two race seats: digitizing intern tracking at CPG with Spring Boot, then shipping the ARSII contact platform with Node.js, React and Docker — built in production, deployed, and online over 99% of the time.

Hackathons are my sprint rounds — a P2 podium at LunarHack with Campus Compass, then Menacraft (Top 5) and LunarHack 2.0 (Top 7) — where speed, teamwork and clear communication matter as much as the code. I hold the same standard in every project: if it isn't deployed and usable, it isn't finished.

experience.company: ARSII — Association for Scientific Research and Innovation in Computing
experience.stack: Node.js · Express · TypeScript · React · Docker · GitHub Actions · Render
experience.description: Built and shipped the platform that centralizes the association's network contacts.
bullets: Set up a GitHub Actions / SonarCloud CI checking tests, lint and quality on every commit, catching regressions before release and saving about 2 hours of manual checks per week.
Containerized the platform with Docker and deployed it on Render, Vercel and Supabase, behind a protected API, keeping it online over 99% of the time.
Developed the React / Node.js platform centralizing 1000+ network contacts, reachable in seconds with no emails or scattered files.

experience.company: CPG — Compagnie des Phosphates de Gafsa
experience.description: Digitized intern tracking for one of Tunisia's largest industrial companies.
bullets: Digitized intern tracking at CPG with Spring Boot and React, turning 40+ paper-based records into files retrieved in seconds.
Designed the REST API and the MySQL schema to give a real-time view of every intern's progress.
Shipped an administration dashboard that gathers all records and updates them in a few clicks.

hackathons.title: LunarHack
hackathons.description: Co-developed Campus Compass, the smart campus assistant for FST (team THE LEGENDARY SANNIN) — implemented the chatbot logic: shortest-path routing between buildings with distance and step-by-step directions, FAQ answering, and multilingual understanding (FR / EN / Tunisian dialect) with auto-suggestions. Also delivered part of the Vite/JS frontend.

hackathons.title: Menacraft
hackathons.description: Co-developed a platform telling authentic content apart from AI-generated content in seconds — implemented the text/image consistency modules behind the confidence score and the React components that make it readable at a glance.

hackathons.title: LunarHack 2.0
hackathons.description: Contributed to a Smart Business Suite automating routine business tasks — developed the AI Marketing Assistant and implemented the backend and automation workflows (FastAPI, n8n, Ollama) so the generation chain runs without manual intervention.
